title: Every Sneeze Lands Me by a STRANGER 🤧
description:
In our town, every sneeze takes you to whoever's thinking about you most. People land in their mom's kitchen, in their dog's bed, once in a boss's office.

Sixty-three sneezes this spring, and every one has put me next to the same old man in a green armchair, with two cups of tea already poured. My mom has never sneezed in her life.

It's made up. A blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: Comment ACHOO if allergy season got you this year.
